status.description: clean = every accepted finding is closed, nothing nearby broke, no work beyond the findings. issues = at least one entry in closed(no|partial), regressions or scope_creep. 'clean' is a legitimate answer — do not manufacture problems to look useful.

summary.description: 2-3 sentences in Russian: what the edits did and what, if anything, is wrong with them. Plain language, no jargon without a gloss.

closed.description: Exactly one entry per accepted finding id given in the input. Do not invent ids.

id.description: Finding id exactly as given in the frozen list (e.g. F1)

closed.description: yes = the diff does what the recommendation asked; partial = addressed but incomplete; no = not addressed or addressed wrongly

why.description: One sentence in Russian grounded in the diff: which added or removed line closes it (or what is still missing)

regressions.description: Places the edits broke or contradicted, outside the finding they were meant to fix. Empty array when there are none.

file.description: Absolute path of the edited file

line.description: Line number in the file AFTER the edits; null when the diff gives no usable number

quote.description: Verbatim quote of the offending line from the diff or the file — no paraphrase

what_broke.description: One sentence in Russian: what stopped working or now contradicts a neighbouring step

scope_creep.description: Changes that go beyond what the accepted findings asked for (rewrites, refactors, 'improvements' nobody requested). Empty array when there are none.

file.description: Absolute path of the edited file

quote.description: Verbatim quote of the added line from the diff

why_beyond_finding.description: One sentence in Russian: which accepted finding this was supposed to serve and why it exceeds it
